Acolyte.description: A faithful practitioner of the holy arts who channels their light to protect allies and banish the undead.

skills.name: Heal
skills.description: Channel holy energy into an ally, restoring HP and leaving gentle Regeneration behind.

skills.name: Codex Mastery
skills.description: Increases Magic Attack with books, staffs, and maces, while improving Healing.

skills.name: Increased Recovery
skills.description: Increases passive MP recovery.

skills.name: Haste
skills.description: Bless an ally with swiftness, clearing Slow and increasing Move Speed and Attack Speed.

skills.name: Benediction
skills.description: Bless nearby allies with divine protection, raising all attributes for a short time.

skills.name: Holy Light
skills.description: Release focused divine light at a single enemy, striking them with Holy force.

skills.name: Divine Grace
skills.description: Bless nearby allies with divine grace, greatly improving natural HP and MP recovery.

skills.name: Sacred Aegis
skills.description: Wrap an ally in divine protection, forming a barrier based on their maximum health.

skills.name: Cure
skills.description: Purify an ally with holy clarity, protecting them from Poison, Blind, and Silence.

skills.name: True Sight
skills.description: Reveal hidden enemies with holy sight, exposing them for a short time.

skills.name: Arcanum Ward
skills.description: Wrap an ally in a sacred ward that reflects Magic damage before hostile spells can reach them.

skills.name: Faith
skills.description: Increases damage against Undead and Shadow enemies, while reducing damage taken from them.

skills.name: Resurrection
skills.description: Return a fallen ally to life, restoring a portion of their HP and spirit.

Berserker.description: A raging juggernaut who cleaves through enemies using heavy weaponry and thrives in no-holds-barred combat.

skills.name: Mighty Roar
skills.description: Let out a mighty roar, empowering nearby allies with increased strength.

skills.name: Earth Splitter
skills.description: Slam the ground with heavy force, staggering enemies and setting them up for your next combo.

skills.name: Dark Claw
skills.description: Rip into the target with savage slashes, causing Bleeding while fueling your Rage.

skills.name: Wild Charge
skills.description: Leap forward with ferocious momentum, crushing enemies and fueling your Rage.

skills.name: Blood Howl
skills.description: Unleash a savage howl that fills nearby allies with bloodlust and battle hunger.

skills.name: Furious Shout
skills.description: Let out a furious battle cry, granting nearby allies Fury and sharpening their critical strikes.

skills.name: Execute
skills.description: Deliver a brutal finishing blow, dealing heavy damage and feeding your Rage.

skills.name: Brutality
skills.description: Increases the maximum number of Rage stacks you can build.

skills.name: Cyclone
skills.description: Spin forward in a violent cyclone, pulling enemies inward and shredding them with repeated strikes.

skills.name: Fearsome Cry
skills.description: Terrify nearby enemies with a savage cry, stunning them while fueling your Rage.

skills.name: Berserk
skills.description: Enter a reckless battle state, greatly increasing combat power while abandoning restraint.

skills.name: Axe Throw
skills.description: Hurl your axe in a brutal arc, striking the target before it snaps back into your grasp.

skills.name: Blood Frenzy
skills.description: Give in to relentless violence, trading control for speed, pressure, and sustain.

skills.name: Increased Regeneration
skills.description: Increases passive HP recovery.

skills.name: Blood Crash
skills.description: Spend stored Rage to recover health instantly and keep regenerating for a short time.

skills.name: Unyielding
skills.description: Consume Rage to steel your body, reducing incoming damage through sheer will.

Gunslinger.description: A ranged specialist who uses a variety of firearms and their mobility to destroy foes both near and far.

skills.name: Suppressive Shot
skills.description: Fire suppressive shots that weaken and mark enemies, setting them up for follow-up attacks.

skills.name: Piercing Shot
skills.description: Fire a piercing rifle round that punches through enemies, staggering and knocking them back.

skills.name: Fan Fire
skills.description: Rapidly unload a burst of shots into one target, building momentum for follow-up fire.

skills.name: Shrapnel
skills.description: Blast enemies with close-range shrapnel, slowing and bleeding those caught in the burst.

skills.name: Explosive Grenade
skills.description: Hurl an explosive charge that detonates in flames, knocking back and burning enemies.

skills.name: Poison Grenade
skills.description: Hurl a toxic grenade that bursts into Poison, leaving deadly ground behind.

skills.name: Sniper Shot
skills.description: Line up a devastating rifle shot, striking with heavy precision damage.

skills.name: Panic Burst
skills.description: Unleash a sudden burst of pistol fire, damaging nearby enemies and finishing prepared combos.

skills.name: Gun Mastery
skills.description: Increases attack with firearms, improves Attack Speed, and allows dual wielding pistols.

skills.name: Point Blank
skills.description: Fire a brutal close-range shotgun blast, blinding enemies and finishing shotgun combos.

skills.name: Freeze Grenade
skills.description: Throw a freezing charge that bursts in an area, immobilizing enemies caught inside.

skills.name: Aerial Shot
skills.description: Leap through the air and fire downward, striking enemies below before landing with evasive grace.

skills.name: Flash Bang
skills.description: Backslide out of danger and prepare a flash grenade for your next move.

skills.name: Jump Shot
skills.description: Leap into battle and fire mid-air, staggering enemies and opening them to a follow-up shot.

skills.name: Trigger Happy
skills.description: Enter a wild firing state, automatically shooting nearby enemies while moving.

skills.name: Lockdown
skills.description: Lock your heavy weapon in place, unleashing sustained fire while holding your ground.

skills.name: Dual Loadout
skills.description: Swap between equipped loadouts, adapting your combat style in the middle of battle.

skills.name: Heavy Loadout
skills.description: Ready a dedicated heavy weapon and swap to it mid-battle to unleash overwhelming firepower. Unlocks Gatling Guns and Launchers

Knight.description: A balanced melee fighter who uses spear and shield to protect allies while felling foes.

skills.name: Taunt
skills.description: Compels inflicted targets to focus their attention on you. Increases Threat generation.

skills.name: Spear Mastery
skills.description: Increases attack with spears, swords, and maces, while raising maximum HP.

skills.name: Shield Mastery
skills.description: Improves Block Chance and defenses while using a shield.

skills.name: Endure
skills.description: Steel yourself against incoming hits, increasing defenses and preventing flinching.

skills.name: Piercing Flurry
skills.description: Open with rapid piercing strikes, cutting through enemies and preparing your next combo.

skills.name: Fortify
skills.description: Increases maximum HP, Vitality, and Healing Received.

skills.name: Twohand Parry
skills.description: Improves your ability to block while using two-handed weapons.

skills.name: Impale
skills.description: Finish them with a strong piercing attack. Increased damage when used as part of a combo.

skills.name: Reflect Shield
skills.description: Reflects a portion of incoming damage back to attackers.

skills.name: Increased Regeneration
skills.description: Increases passive HP recovery.

skills.name: Air Cutter
skills.description: A wide sweeping attack, staggering enemies and making them more susceptible to attacks.

skills.name: Spear Quicken
skills.description: Through disciplined weapon training, the Knight strikes faster and cleaner. Fear the one who has practiced the same technique a thousand times.

skills.name: Weapon Throw
skills.description: Hurl your weapon with precision, slowing your target while you attack from afar.

skills.name: Counter Stance
skills.description: Raise your guard and counter. Blocks attacks and hits back with a stunning blow!

Mage.description: A student of elemental magic who is capable of casting destructive spells from a distance.

skills.name: Wand Mastery
skills.description: Increases Magic Attack with staffs, books, and swords, while improving Cast Speed.

skills.name: Earthbolt
skills.description: Strike a single foe with crushing Earth magic and attune yourself to Earth.

skills.name: Firebolt
skills.description: Launch a concentrated bolt of Fire at one enemy and attune yourself to Fire.

skills.name: Increased Recovery
skills.description: Increases passive MP recovery.

skills.name: Thunderbolt
skills.description: Call down a focused bolt of lightning on one enemy and attune yourself to Wind.

skills.name: Icebolt
skills.description: Ice to meet you! As you hurl a Water shard at your foes.

skills.name: Earth Spikes
skills.description: Rupture the ground with jagged stone, striking enemies and leaving them exposed to Fire.

skills.name: Fireball
skills.description: Launch a fiery orb that explodes on impact, burning enemies and leaving a Firewall behind.

skills.name: True Sight
skills.description: Reveal hidden enemies with holy sight, exposing them for a short time.

skills.name: Thunder Storm
skills.description: Call down a storm of lightning over an area, striking enemies and exposing them to Water damage.

skills.name: Ice Shard
skills.description: This spell is a great ice breaker as you send an ice spike that shatters and freezes your foes.

skills.name: Energy Shield
skills.description: Wrap yourself in arcane protection, redirecting part of incoming damage to MP.

skills.name: Free Cast
skills.description: Allows movement and attacks while casting, with reduced Move Speed and Attack Speed.

skills.name: Blink
skills.description: Teleport to a target location, slipping out of danger and repositioning with precision.

Necromancer.description: A dark spellcaster who commands masses of the dead while twisting the life force of living beings.

skills.name: Summon Abomination
skills.description: Summon a stitched mass of decaying flesh, built to control space through brute force.

skills.name: Summon Skeleton
skills.description: Raise a Bonekin to fight beside you as the backbone of your undead army.

skills.name: Skeleton Mastery
skills.description: Strengthens summons by increasing their Attack, Magic Attack, and resistance.

skills.name: Summon Skeleton Mage
skills.description: Raise a Bonecaster that attacks from range with unstable necromantic magic.

skills.name: Summon Wraith
skills.description: Summon a ghostly undead caster that harasses enemies with dark magic.

skills.name: Bone Spear
skills.description: Hurl a sharpened lance of bone that pierces through flesh and spirit alike.

skills.name: Corpse Barrier
skills.description: Bind stolen bone and life into a grim barrier, shielding yourself through your summon.

skills.name: Scythe Mastery
skills.description: Increases attack with scythes, axes, and swords, while adding HP siphon.

skills.name: Bone Spikes
skills.description: Rupture the ground with jagged bone spikes, impaling enemies caught above them.

skills.name: Death Coil
skills.description: Unleash a coil of undead energy, harming enemies while restoring summoned allies.

skills.name: Corpse Explosion
skills.description: Detonate a Bonekin summon in a burst of necrotic force, causing nearby enemies and summons to explode on death.

skills.name: Harvest
skills.description: Leap forward with a wide scythe swing, staggering enemies and opening them to a finishing strike.

skills.name: Twohand Parry
skills.description: Improves your ability to block while using two-handed weapons.

skills.name: Reanimation
skills.description: Bind the lingering spirit of a fallen boss, claiming it as an undead champion.

skills.name: Life Drain
skills.description: Siphon vitality from enemies, or empower a summon with a dangerous undead surge.

skills.name: Death Bond
skills.description: Bind yourself to an ally, sharing healing and HP siphon between both bonded souls.

skills.name: Reap
skills.description: Carve through nearby enemies with a merciless scythe strike, pulling them in and siphoning HP.

skills.name: Summon Reanimation
skills.description: Call forth a claimed undead champion, returning it to the battlefield.

skills.name: Death Nova
skills.description: Release a burst of necrotic force, rotting nearby enemies and leaving a decaying field behind.

skills.name: Death Spiral
skills.description: Spin into a scythe assault, carving nearby enemies while spreading Decay through each strike.

skills.name: Necrotic Presence
skills.description: The summon radiates necrotic power, empowering nearby allies' Undead damage while weakening enemies.

skills.name: Grave Chill
skills.description: The summon radiates graveborn cold, hastening nearby allies while chilling nearby enemies.

skills.name: Soul Drain
skills.description: The summon radiates a draining aura, helping nearby allies siphon HP and MP from battle.

Paladin.description: A stalwart holy protector who brandishes holy power to both smite foes and protect allies.

skills.name: High Guard
skills.description: Become an impenetrable fortress, increasing Block while becoming difficult to move.

skills.name: Holy Shield
skills.description: May the light bless your shield, increasing Block and All Resistance against all your foes!

skills.name: Faith
skills.description: Increases damage against Undead and Shadow enemies, while reducing damage taken from them.

skills.name: Sacrifice
skills.description: Offer your own HP to the divine, adding Holy damage to each of your blows.

skills.name: Consecration
skills.description: Drop a pillar of light that purifies the surrounding area, burning the unworthy and healing the righteous.

skills.name: Aegis of Light
skills.description: Briefly protect yourself and allies by invoking your faith. Praise the light!

skills.name: Shield Bash
skills.description: Charge! Brace that shield and lunge forth. Crumbling enemy defenses and opening them for further attacks.

skills.name: Sanctify
skills.description: Bless an ally's armor with holy light, changing their armor element to Holy.

skills.name: Judgement Blade
skills.description: This giant Holy sword cleaves through the unworthy, slowing them for further attacks.

skills.name: Divine Punishment
skills.description: Channel your divine might and rain down radiant swords on your unworthy foes!

skills.name: Shield Throw
skills.description: Let the light guide your shield as you hurl it between many foes.

skills.name: Life Bond
skills.description: Link your life to an ally, taking their wounds upon yourself through a sacred bond.

skills.name: Grand Cross
skills.description: Burst forth a radiant cross along the ground, purging a wide area of the unworthy with your holy righteousness!

skills.name: Defiance Aura
skills.description: Radiate unyielding faith, reducing incoming damage for nearby allies.

skills.name: Vitality Aura
skills.description: Emit a gentle divine aura, increasing Vitality and HP recovery for nearby allies.

skills.name: Conviction Aura
skills.description: Radiate unwavering resolve, increasing nearby allies' Melee, Ranged, and Magic damage.

skills.name: Gryphon Riding
skills.description: Call upon your holy gryphon, taking to the battlefield as both rider and radiant blade.

Priest.description: A devoted saint who brings protection and healing to allies and punishes dark creatures with sacred power.

skills.name: High Heal
skills.description: Pour intense holy power into an ally, restoring a massive amount of HP.

skills.name: Salvation
skills.description: Call down celestial light, returning all fallen allies to life with renewed strength.

skills.name: Mace Mastery
skills.description: Increases attack with maces, books, and staffs, while improving Attack Speed.

skills.name: Sanctuary
skills.description: Raise a sacred tree that heals allies and repels undead with holy radiance.

skills.name: Status Recovery
skills.description: Clear Stun, Frozen, Burning, and Decay from an ally, granting brief immunity to each.

skills.name: Turn Undead
skills.description: Attempt to purge Undead and Shadow enemies with divine judgment, dealing massive damage on success.

skills.name: Zeal
skills.description: Inspire an ally with fervent conviction, greatly increasing their damage for a time.

skills.name: Damnation
skills.description: Call down holy judgment, damaging enemies and leaving them exposed to both physical and Magic punishment.

skills.name: Sacred Ground
skills.description: Hallow the ground beneath your allies, reducing damage taken from Ground Effects.

skills.name: Guardian Spirit
skills.description: Conjure a guardian spirit around an ally, shielding them from ranged attacks.

skills.name: Exorcism
skills.description: Call down sacred radiance over an area, pulling enemies inward before blasting them with holy power.

skills.name: Endow Holy
skills.description: Bless an ally's weapon with holy light, converting them to the Holy element.

skills.name: Smite
skills.description: Strike the target with holy force, dealing blessed damage with a chance to stun.

skills.name: Divinity
skills.description: Radiate divine power, strengthening nearby allies while empowering your own healing and holy protection.

skills.name: Sacrament
skills.description: Focus holy will into clarity, empowering Holy magic while improving Cast Speed and Status Duration.

skills.name: Fanaticism
skills.description: Radiate holy zeal, quickening nearby allies while making your own strikes more relentless.

skills.name: Holy Wrath
skills.description: Smite an area with concentrated holy power, silencing enemies and leaving wrathful light behind.

skills.name: Absolution
skills.description: Strip the target clean of buffs and harmful statuses, returning them to a neutral state.

Rogue.description: A nimble fighter who strikes from the shadows with poison and blade.

skills.name: Blade Mastery
skills.description: Increases attack with daggers, swords, twinblades, and katars, while improving Attack Speed.

skills.name: Shadow Step
skills.description: Step through shadow to appear behind the target and strike.

skills.name: Multistrike
skills.description: Gives auto attacks a chance to strike additional times.

skills.name: Venom Strike
skills.description: Strike twice with venomous force, with a chance to apply Poison.

skills.name: Cloaking
skills.description: Blend into shifting shadows, hiding from sight until you attack, cast, or take a hit.

skills.name: Lightning Reflexes
skills.description: Move like living lightning, increasing speed and evasive combat instincts.

skills.name: Venom Coating
skills.description: Coat your attacks in venom, giving each strike a chance to apply Poison.

skills.name: Blade Dance
skills.description: Unleash a flurry of strikes around you, cutting down nearby enemies in rapid motion.

skills.name: Dual Wield Mastery
skills.description: Allows you to wield a weapon in each hand.

skills.name: Enchant Poison
skills.description: Imbue your attacks with the Poison element.

skills.name: Smoke Screen
skills.description: Create a blinding smoke screen, blinding enemies while cloaking yourself.

skills.name: Haste
skills.description: Bless an ally with swiftness, clearing Slow and increasing Move Speed and Attack Speed.

skills.name: Cure
skills.description: Purify an ally with holy clarity, protecting them from Poison, Blind, and Silence.

Scout.description: A swift marksman who excels at striking enemies from afar with archery.

skills.name: Steady Hands
skills.description: Increases bow attack and DEX.

skills.name: Strafing Volley
skills.description: Fire a rapid volley of arrows into a single target.

skills.name: Precise Aim
skills.description: Increases attack range and Hit Rate.

skills.name: Arrow Shower
skills.description: Rain arrows over a wide area, striking enemies repeatedly and forcing them to scatter.

skills.name: Force Shot
skills.description: Fire a powerful shot that knocks enemies back and sets up a combo finisher.

skills.name: Mark Target
skills.description: Mark a target's weak points, reducing their Flee and Critical Defense.

skills.name: Inner Focus
skills.description: Sharpen your focus and reflexes, increasing AGI and DEX for a short time.

skills.name: Slow Trap
skills.description: Spread a shadowy trap across the ground, slowing enemies and leaving them vulnerable.

skills.name: Volatile Bolt
skills.description: Fire a volatile shot that explodes on impact, damaging enemies around the target.

skills.name: Sniper's Nest
skills.description: Take a steady sniper stance, increasing Ranged damage and Critical Damage while greatly reducing movement.

Shinobi.description: An elusive trickster who uses clones and elemental arts to misdirect and overwhelm enemies.

skills.name: Flame Orb
skills.description: Send out a slow orb of unstable flame that erupts into a wide explosion on impact.

skills.name: Binding Spiral
skills.description: Spin with collapsing force, dragging enemies inward before freezing those caught at the center.

skills.name: Flash Step
skills.description: Cross the battlefield in an instant, striking the target area with sudden force.

skills.name: Fire Release
skills.description: Call forth a blazing spirit that crashes down in flames and leaves your attacks wreathed in Fire.

skills.name: Ice Release
skills.description: Call forth a spectral pufferfish that fires icy shards, slowing foes and readying your next spell.

skills.name: Lightning Release
skills.description: Unleash a phoenix of lightning that streaks forward, piercing enemies in its path.

skills.name: Flow State
skills.description: Enter a focused combat rhythm, turning auto attacks into Magic pressure and improving autocast flow.

skills.name: Ninjutsu Mastery
skills.description: Increases cast range, Magic Attack, maximum MP, and MP recovery.

skills.name: Shadow Seal
skills.description: Split your presence through shadow, creating clones to fight alongside you.

skills.name: Shadow Mastery
skills.description: Increases Move Speed, Perfect Dodge, and Spell Dodge.

skills.name: Silent Edge
skills.description: Enter a precise killing stance, increasing critical chance and Critical Damage.

skills.name: Fan Of Knives
skills.description: Scatter a fan of spectral blades, leaping through danger while setting up your next technique.

skills.name: Elusive Feint

skills.name: Twist Of Fate
skills.description: Strike with overwhelming force, stunning and scattering enemies before slipping back into shadows.

skills.name: Shuriken Fan
skills.description: Hurl a spinning shuriken that lingers in place, slicing nearby enemies again and again.

skills.name: Mimic Seal
skills.description: Seal a target's magic and copy its essence, allowing you to cast the spell as your own.

skills.name: Black Blade
skills.description: Launch a whirling crescent of darkness that carves through the target with shadow force.

Summoner.description: A mystical conjurer who fights alongside summoned companions, adapting to fit every scenario.

skills.name: Summon Angel
skills.description: Summon a radiant healer who restores allies and strikes enemies with holy light.

skills.name: Summon Cactus
skills.description: Summon a spiny sentinel that absorbs punishment and strikes back without flinching.

skills.name: Summon Mastery
skills.description: Allows summoned allies to inherit more of your attributes.

skills.name: Summon Cat
skills.description: Summon a nimble caster that darts through battle and blasts enemies with lightning.

skills.name: Summon Wolf
skills.description: Summon a fast, feral brawler that tears into enemies with raw strength and speed.

skills.name: Resonance Well
skills.description: Create a soothing well of resonance, healing allies who remain within its gentle hum.

skills.name: Suppression Field
skills.description: Create a silent field that pulls enemies inward and may seal their ability to cast.

skills.name: Soul Strike
skills.description: Launch a focused burst of Soul magic at a single enemy.

skills.name: Banishment Field
skills.description: Call down a cursed field that twists healing against enemies and leaves them exposed to Magic damage.

skills.name: Dissonance Well
skills.description: Create a dissonant field that damages enemies and slows their movement, attacks, and casting.

skills.name: Conjurer
skills.description: Deepen your bond with summoned allies, improving summon damage and healing power.

skills.name: Guardian Bond
skills.description: Bind an ally with guardian magic, granting Vitality and Regeneration through a shared bond.

skills.name: True Sight
skills.description: Reveal hidden enemies with holy sight, exposing them for a short time.

skills.name: Fury Bond
skills.description: Bind an ally with volatile force, granting Fury and Might through a shared battle surge.

skills.name: Invoker
skills.description: Enter an invoker state, empowering your summons to echo Soul Strike with their own Magic.

skills.name: Summon Command
skills.description: Command your active summons to converge on the chosen target and attack.

skills.name: Summon Recall
skills.description: Recall your active summons, cancelling their actions and bringing them back to your side.

skills.name: Summon Swap
skills.description: Swap your active summon setup, adapting quickly to the fight.

skills.name: Summon Mount
skills.description: Mount your active summon, taking direct control from a stronger battlefield position.

Warrior.description: A powerful combatant who wields heavy axes to deal high damage against multiple foes.

skills.name: Axe Mastery
skills.description: Increases attack with axes, swords, and scythes, and raises critical chance.

skills.name: Bash
skills.description: Smash the target with a crushing blow, with a chance to stun them.

skills.name: Axe Quicken
skills.description: Sharpen your battle rhythm, increasing Attack Speed and critical chance for a short time.

skills.name: Stomp
skills.description: Slam the ground with heavy force, stunning enemies caught in the impact.

skills.name: Twin Cleave
skills.description: Swing twice in wide arcs, cutting through enemies in front of you.

skills.name: Vortex Slash
skills.description: Unleash a spinning slash that damages nearby enemies and pulls them toward you.

skills.name: Whirlwind
skills.description: Spin in place with relentless force, striking all nearby enemies over time.

skills.name: Honed Blade
skills.description: Increases the damage dealt by critical hits.

skills.name: Dual Wield Mastery
skills.description: Allows you to wield a weapon in each hand.

skills.name: Natural Resistance

skills.name: Suppression Field
skills.description: Create a silent field that pulls enemies inward and may seal their ability to cast.

skills.name: Banishment Field
skills.description: Call down a cursed field that twists healing against enemies and leaves them exposed to Magic damage.

skills.name: Natural Resistance
skills.description: Reduces damage taken from all elements.

skills.name: Vortex Slash
skills.description: Unleash a spinning slash that damages nearby enemies and pulls them toward you.

skills.name: Steady Hands
skills.description: Increases bow attack and DEX.

skills.name: Lightning Reflexes
skills.description: Move like living lightning, increasing speed and evasive combat instincts.

skills.name: Benediction
skills.description: Bless nearby allies with divine protection, raising all attributes for a short time.

skills.name: Resonance Well
skills.description: Create a soothing well of resonance, healing allies who remain within its gentle hum.

skills.name: Dissonance Well
skills.description: Create a dissonant field that damages enemies and slows their movement, attacks, and casting.

skills.name: Divine Grace
skills.description: Bless nearby allies with divine grace, greatly improving natural HP and MP recovery.

skills.name: Whirlwind
skills.description: Spin in place with relentless force, striking all nearby enemies over time.

skills.name: Inner Focus
skills.description: Sharpen your focus and reflexes, increasing AGI and DEX for a short time.

skills.name: Dual Wield Mastery
skills.description: Allows you to wield a weapon in each hand.

Wizard.description: An arcane master who channels fire, ice, lightning, and earth into devastating spells.

skills.name: Fire Pillar
skills.description: Summon a pillar of flame from the ground, burning enemies and exposing them to Earth.

skills.name: Avatar of Fire
skills.description: Mastery over Fire lets you assume this avatar state. Increasing Fire damage, Healing Received, and igniting those that dare attack you.

skills.name: Chain Lightning
skills.description: Unleash lightning that jumps between enemies, shocking each target it chains through.

skills.name: Meteor
skills.description: Call down a burning meteor, stunning enemies and leaving them scorched in the blast.

skills.name: Tempest
skills.description: Summon a furious gale that batters enemies, blinds them, and exposes them to Water damage.

skills.name: Avatar of Stone
skills.description: Mastery over earth lets you assume this avatar state. Increasing earth damage, while making you more resistant to attacks.

skills.name: Elemental Overload
skills.description: Unleash a massive elemental eruption based on your current attunement, overwhelming enemies in a wide area.

skills.name: Avatar of Storm
skills.description: Mastery over Wind lets you assume this avatar state. Increasing your Move Speed and discharging a blast of lightning at those that dare attack you.

skills.name: Earthquake
skills.description: Shake the battlefield with violent tremors, stunning enemies caught in the upheaval.

skills.name: Blizzard
skills.description: Unleash a barrage of hail, knocking back foes with the might of ice. A slick spell to keep enemies away.

skills.name: Earth Wall
skills.description: Raise a wall of solid stone, blocking space and shaping the battlefield around you.

skills.name: Avatar of Frost
skills.description: Mastery over Water lets you assume this avatar state. Increasing Water damage, MP Regen, and freezing those that dare attack you.

skills.name: Hydro Vortex
skills.description: Unleash a violent spiral of water, dragging enemies inward and exposing them to Wind.

skills.name: Arcane Sigil
skills.description: Push your magic beyond safe limits, increasing Magic Attack and Cast Speed at the cost of higher MP use.
